name: shiptrack
description: Open-source shipment tracking for Indian and international couriers. Starts with Blue Dart.
//deploy:web: Cloudflare Workers Builds invokes `npm run deploy:web` as its BUILD command, on every branch — so this script must only build, never deploy. Deploying is the build trigger's own job: `wrangler deploy` on main, `wrangler versions upload` on other branches. If this script deploys, every branch push ships to production. Use `npm run deploy` for a manual full deploy.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && npm run deploy:poller
scripts.db:migrate: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute shiptrack --file=$f || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute shiptrack --remote --file=$f || exit 1; done
